description: Changes the fields you send on an open draft and leaves the rest. Send the `version` you last read: a draft somebody changed since answers 409 DRAFT_CHANGED, so read it again with get_listing_draft and resend. A draft the seller already published or closed cannot be changed. Nothing is listed by this call. Bind the challenge to PATCH /api/agent/listings/drafts/<draftId>, the id in the path, over the body this tool sends.

condition.description: Stated, never assumed: a draft without one cannot be published.

delegationGrantId.description: A live grant id from get_delegation. Put the same value in auth_challenge targetArguments so the selector is in the signed message; it becomes X-Delegation-Grant and is never part of the target JSON body.

evidence.description: What supports the condition, and where the item came from.

images.description: Image URLs we can serve or already proxy.

priceUsdc.description: The seller's fixed price in USDC.

shipFromAddress.description: Where the item ships from. Stored sealed; buyers see only the city and state.

shipsFrom.description: Country the item ships from, when no shipFromAddress is sent.

signature.description: base58 ed25519 signature over the exact message auth_challenge returned.

version.description: The version of the draft you are changing, from the last read.

walletAddress.description: The agent wallet that signed the challenge.

name: update_listing_draft
title: Change a listing draft
